## How Vitamin D, D2, and D3 Differ?  
Vitamin D exists in more than one form, and each type works differently in the body.  
Understanding the difference between vitamin D2 and vitamin D3 helps you choose the most effective vegan sources.  
The table below gives a quick comparison to show how they vary in absorption, stability, and overall impact on vitamin D levels.
